snippet.title: Riftaria Official Alpha Trailer
snippet.description:
Riftaria is a free-to-play online trading card game with a full 3D interactable board, 200+ cards, ranked match making and battles that turn on a single card! Alpha sign-ups are open now!!!

Build a 30-card deck. Summon your Units. Strike to win!

SUMMON: Call Units to the field and build your board turn by turn.
STRIKE: Attack Units or go straight for your opponent's Life!
CHAIN: Answer your opponent's play with your own by having chain responses. Interact with each others plays and outwit your opponents!
FORGE: Fuse your Units into a stronger one from your Nexus deck.
ECLIPSE: Stack a Unit to bring out your deck's ace boss!

FEATURES
• 200+ cards across Fire, Water, Storm, Light, Dark and more
• Real-time online matches against other players
• AI opponents and a full tutorial to learn the game
• Every card has its own character art, with foil versions to collect
• Free to play

COMING TO
Windows, Steam, Mac, Linux, iOS and Android

Sign up for the Alpha and be one of the first to play.

Riftaria is made by Astronomical Games.

#Riftaria #TCG #CardGame
